moments.text: Grey IR view of a curving dark channel between flat ground and bright pitted terrain, crosshair and black masking boxes; disclosure notice along the bottom.
The view pans: the channel slides off to the upper right, leaving plain grey ground. A tiny dark dot shows at the upper left.
Plain grey ground; the dark dot drifts around the crosshair: upper left at 9 s, just below at 11 s, lower right by 12.8 s.
Split screen: grey view left, pinkish colour view right. From 15.5 s a dark dot crosses the colour side from lower right toward upper left.
Grey full view for 2 s, then the split screen returns at 21.4 s; no dot stands out.
Long grey IR stretch over streaky ground; a small black box masks the spot just below the crosshair, and faint dark specks come and go.
Split screen again: a dark dot sits just above the crosshair on both halves, then slides left, leaving the grey side's left edge by 1:21.
Split screen with plain ground on both sides; the dot is gone.
Back to the full grey view: a tiny dark dot wanders near the crosshair, mostly left of it, often hard to see.
The view pans across a dark channel with bumpy banks, then along a broad dark band low in the frame.
Plain grey ground to the end; the dark band fades out at the bottom.
